commands.name: add
commands.description: Adds a set of business files to the project(s)

options.name: --scaffold
options.description: Type of scaffold to generate. Acceptable values are: application, domain, controller and full.

options.name: --type
options.description: Type of structure to generate. Acceptable values are: base, list, search and entity.

options.name: --idType
options.description: Type of the ID. It can be any C# valid type for IDs.

options.name: --entity
options.description: Entity name (using the exact format, ie: companycategory != CompanyCategory).

options.name: --entityPlural
options.description: Plural entity name (using the exact format, ie: companycategories != CompanyCategories).

options.name: --inputModel
options.description: Input type (using the exact format, ie: categoryinput/model != CategoryInput/Model).

options.name: --responseModel
options.description: Response type (using the exact format, ie: categoryresponse/model != CategoryResponse/Model).

options.name: --applicationProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the application layer.

options.name: --contractsProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the contracts layer.

options.name: --domainProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the domain layer.

options.name: --userInterfaceProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the UserInterface layer.

options.name: --modelsProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the models layer.

options.name: --persistenceProject
options.description: Name of the project representing the persistence layer.

options.name: --projectPrefix
options.description: Prefix of the projects to be created.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: structure
commands.description: Creates the solution and/or projects structure

options.name: --type
options.description: Type of structure to generate. Acceptable values are: full-with-sln, full, app, domain, contracts, ui, persistence, models, migrations.

options.name: --newSolutionName
options.description: Name of the solution to be created.

options.name: --projectPrefix
options.description: Prefix of the project(s) to be created.

options.name: --databaseType
options.description: Type of database. Acceptable values are: sqlserver, mysql, sqlite, postgres.

options.name: --mappingTool
options.description: Mapping tool. Acceptable values are: mapster, automapper.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
